title: Initiative Labs — Quarterly roadmap for experimental feature lanes and model roster pruning
creator: Samira Patel
project: Initiative Labs: Hosted API + Model Roster
description: This ticket defines a tightly scoped quarterly program ('Initiative Labs') to run parallel experimental lanes for Hosted API feature bursts while concurrently pruning and gating the model roster. The goal is to validate 3 high-impact product experiments that directly influence unit economics or latency SLAs, and to retire or gate underperforming model variants from the hosted catalog with clear acceptance gates.
goals: Deliver 3 experiment lanes with measurable impact on latency or token cost
Establish a repeatable gating rubric for model roster removals and restrictions
Ship two lightweight console views for experiment telemetry and model gating decisions
Reduce median token cost for targeted workloads by at least 8% across experiment treatments
scope_inclusions: Experiment A: adaptive batching knobs exposed to customers (beta)
Experiment B: structured-output templates with model-specific fallback
Experiment C: reactive model routing by cost/latency (region-aware) for 3 endpoints
Model roster audit for hosted catalog (identify candidates for deprecation or gated launch)
Console telemetry tiles for experiment cohorts and roster-change rationale
scope_exclusions: Large-scale kernel/runtime changes that require >1 quarter of infra work
success_metrics: Experiment lanes: statistically significant improvement (p < 0.05) on primary metric per experiment
Token unit cost delta <= -8% for at least one targeted workload
Console telemetry adoption: 60% of participating engineers use tiles during decision windows
Model roster decisions: at least 5 catalog items gated or scheduled for deprecation with owner signoff
milestones: 2025-11-25: Experiment designs finalized and signed off by PM + Eng + Design
2025-12-05: Engineering spikes and required infra feature flags landed
2025-12-15: Beta rollout of Experiment A and B to 5% traffic
2026-01-10: Complete 2-week analysis window and convene gating review
2026-01-20: Publish roster pruning decisions and deprecation schedule
2026-01-31: Closeout report and RFC for next quarter's Initiative Labs
risks: Insufficient traffic for statistically significant results within quarter
Cross-team dependencies (runtime team, console team) delay rollouts
Customer complaints if experimental routing increases tail latency for some customers
Model vendor/OSS licensing signals impacting model roster choices
tasks: PM: finalize experiment hypotheses and primary metrics
Eng: implement feature flags and traffic-splitting hooks (spike -> PRs)
Design: prototype telemetry tile and gating decision UI
Analytics: prepare baseline cohorts and instrumentation for A/B analysis
Security: review routing changes for data residency implications
Docs: draft customer-facing beta announcement and opt-out instructions
acceptance_criteria: All three experiments have a launch checklist and at least one initial cohort receiving traffic
Instrumentation emits primary metrics and sample-size estimates in the analytics workspace
Console tiles display cohort-level token cost and P95 latency for experiment treatments
Model roster audit completed and each candidate has a recommended action plus an owner
